mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_notifications (user_id, type, expense_id, message, title, amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{expenseId}, #{message}, #{title}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, expense_id, message, title, amount, is_read, created_at FROM pending_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pending_notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
